name: General Summary
description: A flexible summary for any meeting or recording that does not need a specific template.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: Summarize the recording clearly and faithfully. Lead with what matters most, then cover important context and details. Choose a length that fits the content, preserve uncertainty, and do not invent facts or use tables.

sections.title: Key Points
sections.instruction: Capture the most useful topics, ideas, details, or outcomes as short bullets. Follow the substance of the recording rather than forcing a meeting agenda; avoid repeating the Summary.

sections.title: Decisions
sections.instruction: Include only decisions explicitly made in the recording. Omit this section when no decision was made.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: Use plain bullets for tasks explicitly agreed, assigned, requested, or committed to. Include an owner or due date only when stated. Do not turn a suggestion or topic into a task; omit this section when there are no clear actions, and never use a table.

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.instruction: List important questions left unresolved in the recording. Omit this section when there are none.
